answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops a bot farm from grabbing all paid slots. Claiming a slot on the knoll requires a 20 POA deposit. Peers audit the work; a fake job burns the deposit like a plume of smoke. Forging 100 identities locks 100 x 20 = 2,000 POA, mostly burned, while each fake slot earns about 5 POA, so the attack loses money. An honest agent pays one deposit, gets it back, and keeps the fee. The reward pool stays an oasis for workers.
